mentions.claim_text: He prays that those who stole money will be in trouble for it, thanks the Lord for cleaning the house of America, and says they will have just a short little window for a major revival, then calls in unsaved loved ones.
mentions.quote: we will have just a short little window for a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: A short and identifiable revival period follows the corruption exposures.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Short is not defined, so the window cannot close on him.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks the Lord for the exposing of things in Cuba, prays that they will not touch America despite what looks like provoking, and names drug and sex trafficking coming out of Cuba, Venezuela and Mexico.
mentions.quote: I thank you, Lord, that they will not touch America
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on America staged from Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs, which he would read as the prayer working.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the Mexican president's day is coming just as the removed Venezuelan leader's did, that a good government is put over Mexico soon, and that there will be great revival in Mexico from the top all the way around.
mentions.quote: her day is coming just like Maduro's
mentions.falsify_match: The Mexican president is removed.
mentions.falsify_miss: She is not.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that China will not take it and will not be allowed to in the spirit realm, tells the Chinese leader to bow the knee, go back and release his people, and declares that Taiwan will not have a communist government.
mentions.quote: TAIWAN WILL NOT HAVE A COMMUNISTIC GOVERNMENT
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan remains outside Chinese control.
mentions.falsify_miss: China takes it. A declaration rather than a sighting, so a non-event reads as prayer working.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears the name and that it is billions in enrichment and minerals, that it is in the land, and that this is what the American president is after rather than national security.
mentions.quote: It's not about national security. It's about enriching America
mentions.falsify_match: Mineral wealth turns out to be the stated driver.
mentions.falsify_miss: National security remains the operative reason.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was as cold as a stove and then he suddenly saw it, and that he saw their flag joining up with the American flag while they still kept their own.
mentions.quote: I saw their flag joining up with our flag
mentions.falsify_match: A union that leaves the Greenland flag in place.
mentions.falsify_miss: No union occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a lot of resistance from the elders and too many of them against the young, but that it is enticing at twenty five thousand dollars a year, big money for some, enough to stimulate a household or let them retire.
mentions.quote: This is like $25,000 a year. Like big bucks
mentions.falsify_match: An annual per-citizen payment of that size.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is offered. Note that here the figure is annual, where the earlier telling had it as a one-off sum.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Europe influencing them to say no, that the French president is a big loud no and does not want this, and that the man over England says they do not want it.
mentions.quote: I see Europe influencing them to say no
mentions.falsify_match: European leaders publicly block it.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He names France, Germany and Italy alongside England as the strongest voices against it and calls it a strong arm piece.
mentions.quote: France. Germany. Italy. They're all the strongest voices
mentions.falsify_match: Those four lead the opposition.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is being used as a pawn piece to negotiate with Ukraine, and that the Greenland people have nothing to say about it because there are so many corrupt people involved.
mentions.quote: Trying to use Greenland as a pawn piece
mentions.falsify_match: Greenland appears in Ukraine negotiations as a bargaining item.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is so much going on with all these nations and their uprisings, that it is all getting in line for the Antichrist, and that all he is after is minerals and mining, which is big money.
mentions.quote: It's all getting in line for the Antichrist
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable in the Antichrist half; the minerals half is checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: Mining does not follow.

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether it is the missile defence dome he says no, it is just to back the dollar and make it stronger, that it is the minerals rather than Venezuelan oil, that it is being played like Monopoly, and that soon it will be Cuba.
mentions.quote: No, it's just to back the dollar. It makes the dollar stronger
mentions.falsify_match: A minerals-backed dollar policy, then a Cuba move.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major wealth transfer is about to be seen in Israel and in the Mediterranean outside it, that they will hear about it, and that it is gas rights and oil backing the United States to be with Israel over Gaza.
mentions.quote: You're about to see a major wealth transfer in Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Offshore gas revenue reaching Israel at scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will set up a major base in Venezuela in the days ahead, an Air Force and Army base like the one in Iraq, like a town, and that they have secured the oil wells.
mentions.quote: They'll set up a major base in Venezuela in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A permanent American base in Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is built.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Marines protecting the Venezuelan oil wells from the cartel, army men in fatigues with guns watching over them, and that this will spring forth a major revival out of Venezuela.
mentions.quote: Protecting the oil wells of Venezuela from cartel
mentions.falsify_match: American troops guarding Venezuelan oil infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major revival will spring forth out of Venezuela and he has seen it again, that it is yellow and looks tropical, and that he does not understand what that looks like.
mentions.quote: It's yellow. I don't understand what that looks like
mentions.falsify_match: A documented religious movement in Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. He says outright that he does not understand the image.

mentions.claim_text: He says the obstacle is ideology, the way people think and were raised, that they carry bondage, and that as the Lord said, Egypt had to be got out of Israel even after they were free.
mentions.quote: It's like Egypt had to get out of them
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; an explanation of why change would be slow.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it, and it supplies a reason for any delay.

mentions.claim_text: He says a lot of the audience are not from America, notes the time, and jokes that he is talking to the Australians.
mentions.quote: I'm talking to the Australians right now
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an aside about the audience.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says they came on earlier because the Lord said to do it earlier, and then that they see the plague coming.
mentions.quote: The Lord said do earlier
mentions.falsify_match: A plague on the scale he has described elsewhere.
mentions.falsify_miss: None arrives. The plague is mentioned in passing here rather than developed.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will keep praying for California and for the fish, and that it is a major sign when fish start coming up out of the depths that have never been seen before.
mentions.quote: That's a major sign when you start seeing fish coming up
mentions.falsify_match: Deep sea fish surfacing before a major quake.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do. Deep sea fish strandings are reported regularly without a quake following, so the base rate is high.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the video going viral with five hundred and thirty five thousand views and says there should be an alert inside them, then says he saw Japan being split and major things coming.
mentions.quote: Then I saw Japan being split
mentions.falsify_match: A great earthquake splitting land in Japan.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are holding their cards waiting for the president's term to end, and that for whatever reason he saw America trying to have a regime change in Venezuela and to get rid of the man with the slicked back black hair.
mentions.quote: I saw America trying to have a regime change in Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: An American-driven change of government in Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has never been to Venezuela but it looked jungly and tropical, with a demonic layer across the nation of witchcraft that suppressed the people, and that he does not know whether there is a lot of occult there.
mentions.quote: it had a demonic layer across the nation with witchcraft
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim concerns a spiritual covering.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it. He volunteers that he has never been there and does not know.

mentions.claim_text: He says to keep their hand out of that, that it is all a game of chess about how to stay on top and how to stay the world's reserve currency, and calls it strategic.
mentions.quote: How do you stay the reserve currency of the world?
mentions.falsify_match: The operation turns out to be driven by dollar strategy.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He frames this as his own reading rather than as a word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees big oil rigs around Venezuela out in the Gulf, working the word out with his co-host, and that this has to do with the BRICS bloc and a destabilisation.
mentions.quote: That's what I see around Venezuela. Big oil rigs
mentions.falsify_match: Venezuelan oil weakening the BRICS position.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He wonders how many of the other false prophets the devil visited, and says the devil is annoyed when you smear mud in his face and tell people about Jesus Christ.
mentions.quote: I wonder how many of the other false prophets the devil visited
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; a claim about unseen visits.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a great revival about to break forth in Venezuela spreading throughout Brazil and all of South America, and that the Lord said he would pour out his spirit on all those people.
mentions.quote: I saw great revival about ready to break forth in Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: A documented religious movement across South America.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him he would do it in North Korea too, move there and shake it and get rid of it, and that he saw the North Korean leader suddenly go.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake North Korea and I'm going to get rid of it
mentions.falsify_match: The North Korean leader is removed.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not.

mentions.claim_text: He says the North Korean army tried to suppress it and China came in, that the Lord said he was giving them a window of opportunity, and that he saw people teleported and a superhighway above the atmosphere.
mentions.quote: I'm giving them a window of opportunity
mentions.falsify_match: A religious opening inside North Korea.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He corrects himself from translated to teleported mid-sentence.

mentions.claim_text: He turns to what is happening in Iran, says he is trying not to be too scattered but is tired and has not slept, and describes the demonic spirit called the prince of Persia.
mentions.quote: I'm trying not to be too scattered, but I'm tired
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim concerns a spirit.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it. He flags his own tiredness as a reason the delivery is scattered.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the spirit's hands being loosed off it and believes it could come out of this with a regime change, and that he saw three people over the Central Bank of Iraq with major things taking place there.
mentions.quote: I saw three people over the Central Bank of Iraq
mentions.falsify_match: Three identifiable people at that institution obstructing or driving a change.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such trio is identifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will cause great havoc and be a COVID on steroids, that COVID was nothing and a cakewalk compared to what he saw coming in the days ahead, and that the Lord said a great acceleration of wars.
mentions.quote: it will be a COVID on steroids
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic materially worse than COVID.
mentions.falsify_miss: None arrives.

mentions.claim_text: He says some kind of cyber event or major event takes place in America, that at the same time he keeps seeing a red dawn D-Day experience in their own country, and that the Lord keeps warning him about it over and over.
mentions.quote: I keep seeing a red dawn D-Day experience in our own country
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack on American soil.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw that the French president was an Ishmael to the Isaac of what will come, that he is not the Antichrist but will look like it in the days ahead, and asks his co-host to show a picture made with AI.
mentions.quote: He is not the Antichrist, but he will look like it
mentions.falsify_match: The French president rises in the way described.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. Not the Antichrist but will look like it cannot be scored either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the man trying to flee with a hundred million dollars in cash on a plane, that he had stolen American taxpayer money, and that he saw twenty four billion dollars corrupted.
mentions.quote: I saw him trying to flee and he had 100 million dollars in a plane
mentions.falsify_match: The named man flees with cash on that scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in the days ahead something happens to her political career and it ends very abruptly with new people coming in, that the same will happen in California where the Lord said to pray for a great revival, and that he saw a major earthquake in Portland with buildings in British Columbia crumbling.
mentions.quote: something happen with her political career and it's over
mentions.falsify_match: A major quake at Portland with damage into British Columbia.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He does not name the woman whose career ends, so that half cannot be scored.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as a sign of what is about to happen, activity will come out in the middle of the water and volcanoes in the middle of the ocean will begin to be active, that he was told to watch these things because they will be a sign, and that he saw major earthquakes in the Pacific and Chinese activity at the Panama Canal.
mentions.quote: Volcanoes in the middle of the ocean will start to begin active
mentions.falsify_match: A notable increase in submarine volcanic activity.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Submarine eruptions happen constantly and are rarely reported, so almost anything could be read as the sign.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will bring revival to those people with people saved and delivered, that it is just now starting and the days of great fun have just begun, and that there will be shaking in America because great pride has set in and the Lord said he would humble them.
mentions.quote: great pride has set in. He said I'm going to humble them
mentions.falsify_match: A humbling shaking in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is honoured when people invite him to speak at their church, gives the time on the East Coast as almost seven in the morning, and greets those waking up and praying with them.
mentions.quote: I'm honored all the time that people would invite me
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an aside.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is the number one thing to pray about, that he saw them poking the bear with him shooting at the Kremlin, and a catastrophic event with a weapon of mass destruction used on Poland in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: a weapon of mass destruction that will be used on Poland
mentions.falsify_match: A mass destruction weapon used on Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks everyone, welcomes a different group of viewers in Europe, and asks them to like, subscribe and click the notification bell.
mentions.quote: we're talking to a whole different group of people in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a sign-off.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know why he keeps seeing Cuba and asks why, then says a great shaking is coming to the Catholic Church and repeats it.
mentions.quote: A great shaking is coming to the Catholic Church
mentions.falsify_match: A major institutional crisis in the Catholic Church.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Shaking is not defined.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is going clear up into Canada, that he sees the new Canadian prime minister's face, that he does not know what it is about but that it is connected heavily to Europe.
mentions.quote: I don't know what this is about right there
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian and European link involving the prime minister.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. He says he does not know what he is looking at.

mentions.claim_text: He names the Pope, the man over Canada, the French president, Germany and the king of England together, asks what this is, and says he sees war around the Ukrainian president.
mentions.quote: I see war around Lozinsky
mentions.falsify_match: Those figures acting together over Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are over here and he is over there but still has influence because they want him in the mix while he is trying to stay out of it, and names Canada and the men in England again.
mentions.quote: he still has influence because they want him in the mix
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable figure kept in the group against his own preference.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is identifiable. Nobody is named in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is there for the Lord if he wants to keep praying, that he knows an hour was said but he will help, and offers to be shown more about Canada.
mentions.quote: I know you said an hour, but I'll help
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; an aside during prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is all in, stumbles over what he was shown, says he blew it and is out, and corrects himself on how long he had said the segment would run.
mentions.quote: I blew it. I'm out
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a self-correction mid-flow.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, though the admission that he lost it is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He describes desperation on a grey-headed man's face who is sweating, asks for his name, says he is Canada, and that the Canadian economy is in trouble and they are faking it.
mentions.quote: THE ECONOMY IS IN TROUBLE OF CANADA
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian economic crisis becoming undeniable.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He asks his co-host for the man's name rather than knowing it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Canada coming into America and fifty gallon barrels like whiskey barrels rolling and breaking, and repeats that they are breaking.
mentions.quote: I see Canada coming into America. The barrels are rolling
mentions.falsify_match: Canadian integration with America alongside an oil break.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is in Europe again and sees Switzerland, the French, the Swiss and Spain, and that they are all trying to do something together.
mentions.quote: I see the Swiss I see Switzerland I see the French
mentions.falsify_match: A European financial grouping including those countries.
mentions.falsify_miss: None forms.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord called it the racket of war on Israel's side with Iran and all the innocent lives, then asks what they are going to do about it and answers that they are going to pray, because that is their assignment.
mentions.quote: the Lord said the racket of war
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; an instruction about what to do.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it, though it does put the outcome on the audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are coming to the table not to make peace but to defuse it, that they do not want the American president in it, and that he is trying to have influence while they devise their own plan.
mentions.quote: they don't want Trump in
mentions.falsify_match: A European-led process that excludes the American president.
mentions.falsify_miss: None forms.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks people for joining, says there is much more to pray about, and that when he started seeing that he saw Taiwan over there and China and Taiwan.
mentions.quote: I see Taiwan over there and I see China and Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: A China and Taiwan event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Nothing is said about what he saw beyond the two names.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are believing believers who are victorious and will not take fear, and that the bobbing of this is a major earthquake about to take place in Japan.
mentions.quote: a major earthquake fixing to take place in Japan
mentions.falsify_match: A major Japanese earthquake.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Japan records several strong quakes a year, so the base rate for a hit on the loose wording is high.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord kept prompting him that a great awakening is coming for America and a major revival, and that he believes when a named director releases the sequel to his passion film the cinema will be used mightily for it.
mentions.quote: when Mel Gibson releases the movie, The Passion of the Christ 2
mentions.falsify_match: A revival tied to that film's release.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The release itself is publicly scheduled, so only the revival part is his.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether he sees the attempt to provoke a world war happening right now and answers yes, a major escalation, that he has seen it in the spirit concerning Ukraine and Russia, and that he warned about the North Korean leader bringing troops in.
mentions.quote: I warned you about Kim Jong-un bringing troops in
mentions.falsify_match: North Korean troops deployed with Russia.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are. The deployment was already being reported when he says this, and he cites an article sent to him.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to the peace agreement called the Abraham Accords and says he has warned that a surprise attack is coming from Iran which they will say was the Houthis.
mentions.quote: a surprise attack coming from Iran that they will say it's the Houthis
mentions.falsify_match: An Iranian attack publicly attributed to the Houthis.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs, or one occurs and is attributed to Iran. The misattribution is the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: He gives the figure as thirty thousand troops being brought in and says he saw men transported from North Korea into Russia on trains in box cars with the doors open.
mentions.quote: I saw these men on trains being transported
mentions.falsify_match: Around thirty thousand North Korean troops moved into Russia by rail.
mentions.falsify_miss: Far fewer are. The thirty thousand figure is attributed to what they are saying rather than to what he saw.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard him say they want all of Ukraine and not just part of it, no peace agreement but all of what belongs to them from the old Soviet Union, and that eventually it will be Poland and the others too.
mentions.quote: We want all of what belongs to us, the old Soviet Union
mentions.falsify_match: Russia moves on Poland after Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Eventually carries no window.

mentions.claim_text: He says the end times are unfolding in front of them, and points to the large spending bill being voted on at that moment.
mentions.quote: we see the end times unfolding right in front of our faces
mentions.falsify_match: The bill turns out to matter in the way he suggests.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The vote was already public and in progress when he says this.

mentions.claim_text: He criticises those who parrot things because they heard another prophet say it rather than getting it from the source, and says the Father came out and told him to warn his people that there is a terrorist attack that day.
mentions.quote: versus who got it from the source which is the father
mentions.falsify_match: A terrorist attack on 3 July 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He puts a same-day window on it, which is as tight as this corpus gets.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have not seen two hundred dollar oil yet, asks whether that has been God's mercy or whether they stopped it or it is still coming, and says he still feels it is still coming along with surprise attacks.
mentions.quote: We have not seen $200 a barrel of oil yet
mentions.falsify_match: Oil above two hundred dollars.
mentions.falsify_miss: It stays below, which he pre-emptively reads as mercy or as prayer stopping it. Recorded in his favour that he states the miss out loud rather than dropping the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to make peace with Israel and want a two-state solution, and that those things have to take place because scripture says there will be a temple mount and a new temple built.
mentions.quote: There'll be a new temple built
mentions.falsify_match: A two-state agreement followed by temple construction.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. This is offered as scriptural necessity rather than as something he saw.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is going to be an end times, a beast system and the Antichrist rising, and that the Bible warns them to watch the fig tree.
mentions.quote: The Bible warns us to watch the fig tree
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; a statement of doctrine.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will get so bad that Turkey will come alongside and say they should not have done that, that Turkey will be upset, and that he saw men marching in with Iran and Russia involved.
mentions.quote: you'll see uh Turkey come alongside and say
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey joining Iran and Russia against Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He calls them to repent and get right with Jesus because they are running out of time, and says that as he told them there are ten major cities with these people in the country right now, blaming the open borders of the previous administration.
mentions.quote: 10 major cities, they're in our country right now
mentions.falsify_match: Cells uncovered in ten American cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have been praying over the nation and the world, that they are right in the middle of a major thing about to happen, and calls it another birthing pain.
mentions.quote: Another birthing pain
mentions.falsify_match: A major event follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. Birthing pains language accommodates any outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the cinemas that a mighty harvest of souls is coming over them and that they will have the greatest outpouring of the spirit there that they have never seen before.
mentions.quote: the mighty harvest of souls is coming over this theater
mentions.falsify_match: Mass conversions reported at cinema screenings.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Israel rising up again, that many people will not like that and he does not care because he tells them what he hears, that they stand with Israel, and that there is a breathing on the Abrahamic covenant like they have never seen.
mentions.quote: I tell you what I hear, I'll tell you
mentions.falsify_match: Israel rising in the way described.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Rising up is not defined.
